Cricket final

The **2023 Cricket World Cup Final** was a [One Day International](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/One_Day_International "One Day International") [cricket](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cricket "Cricket") match played at the [Narendra Modi Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Narendra_Modi_Stadium "Narendra Modi Stadium") in [Ahmedabad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ahmedabad "Ahmedabad"), on 19 November 2023 to determine the winner of the [2023 Cricket World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Cricket_World_Cup "2023 Cricket World Cup").[[2]](#cite_note-2) It was played between host nation [India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India_national_cricket_team "India national cricket team") and [Australia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia_national_cricket_team "Australia national cricket team").[[3]](#cite_note-3) It was the first time that [Ahmedabad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Narendra_Modi_Stadium "Narendra Modi Stadium") hosted a [Cricket World Cup final](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Cricket_World_Cup_finals "List of Cricket World Cup finals").[[4]](#cite_note-4) It was the second time that India and Australia played a World Cup final against each other, after the [2003 final](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2003_Cricket_World_Cup_final "2003 Cricket World Cup final").[[5]](#cite_note-5)

In the final, Australia defeated India to win a record-extending sixth World Cup title. The comfortable Australian victory, with seven overs to spare, is considered one of the bigger upsets in World Cup history, due to the heavily favoured India going undefeated through the entire tournament up until this point.[[6]](#cite_note-6)[[7]](#cite_note-7)[[8]](#cite_note-8)

[Australia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia_national_cricket_team "Australia national cricket team") qualified for a record-extending eighth time in the final, after defeating South Africa in the semi-finals; having won five ([1987](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987_Cricket_World_Cup_final "1987 Cricket World Cup final") against England, [1999](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999_Cricket_World_Cup_final "1999 Cricket World Cup final") against Pakistan, [2003](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2003_Cricket_World_Cup_final "2003 Cricket World Cup final") against current finalist India, [2007](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2007_Cricket_World_Cup_final "2007 Cricket World Cup final") against Sri Lanka, and [2015](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_Cricket_World_Cup_final "2015 Cricket World Cup final") against New Zealand) and lost two ([1975](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1975_Cricket_World_Cup_final "1975 Cricket World Cup final") to the West Indies and [1996](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1996_Cricket_World_Cup_final "1996 Cricket World Cup final") to Sri Lanka).[[17]](#cite_note-17)

# ICC announces 2023 World Cup schedule; Narendra Modi Stadium set to host the final

Five matches will be played in Ahmedabad, which includes the highly-anticipated clash between India and Pakistan.

27 June, 2023

Share

![](/static-assets/images/lazy-load.png)

The schedule for the ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup 2023 has been announced and the marquee event will begin on October 5. The Narendra Modi Stadium will stage the opening match of the tournament between last edition’s finalists England and New Zealand, and the grand finale on November 19.  

The Indian contingent will begin their quest for glory on October 8 against Australia at the MA Chidambaram Stadium, Chennai. Champions of the 1983 and 2011 editions, Team India reached the semi-finals of the previous two World Cups in 2015 and 2019. 

The Men in Blue will be playing all of their nine group stage matches across nine venues and Ahmedabad will be hosting a very special fixture. The iconic stadium will host the high-octane match between India and Pakistan on October 15. 

Ahmedabad will be hosting two other matches during the group stages - England vs Australia on November 4 and South Africa vs Afghanistan on November 10. 

The world’s biggest stadium will brace itself for the biggest match in international cricket on November 19, when the two best teams of the tournament will face each other in the summit clash. 

**ICC World Cup 2023 matches in Ahmedabad**

* **England vs New Zealand**, October 5
* **India vs Pakistan**, October 15
* **England vs Australia**, November 4
* **South Africa vs Afghanistan**, November 10
* **Final**, November 19

**Indian team schedule for ICC World Cup 2023**

* **India vs Australia**, October 8, Chennai
* **India vs Afghanistan**, October 11, Delhi
* **India vs Pakistan**, October 14, Ahmedabad
* **India vs Bangladesh**, October 19, Pune
* **India vs New Zealand**, October 22, Dharamsala
* **India vs England**, October 29, Lucknow
* **India vs Sri Lanka**, November 2, Mumbai
* **India vs South Africa,** November 5, Kolkata
* **India vs Netherlands**, November 12, Bengaluru
